subject: R session aborting as model starts to run with tMsPGOcc()

messages.author: 2481dd60d74e4239
messages.subject: R session aborting as model starts to run with tMsPGOcc()
parts:
Hi group,

I'm helping out with a multi-species, multi-season model, using data from 5 species, 87 sites, 10 primary periods (years) and 32 secondary periods. I'm running into a problem where my R session aborts as soon as I start running the model using tMsPGOcc() [in RStudio,  the pop-up says that the R Session Aborted; R encountered a fatal error; The session was terminated). 

I've tried to troubleshoot by running a multi-species model with each years' data individually, as well as running a multi-season model with each species' data individually. All of these models run fine. 

Has anyone encountered a similar issue or have any ideas on what my be going wrong? I've tried to triple check my data structure against examples and I believe it is set up correctly from what I can tell. I've also made sure to use MCMC criteria that result in whole numbers.




Thanks in advance for any thoughts!
Sara

messages.author: 0b274a0ee3490d75
messages.subject: Re: R session aborting as model starts to run with tMsPGOcc()
parts:
Hi Sara, 

Hope all is well! I think I know what's going on here. There is a bug in tMsPGOcc() that prevents it from working under certain formats of the input data. Long story short, if there is no site in your data set that is sampled for all 32 secondary periods in at least one year, tMsPGOcc() will crash. This type of data formatting is often common with camera trapping data (e.g., if the secondary periods are days and each camera is only running for some of those days). I fixed this with all the other functions (hence why you're getting to work), tMsPGOcc() just somehow slipped through when I made the update to CRAN. Here's some more info: https://github.com/biodiverse/spOccupancy/issues/45. 

All that to say, if you install the development version from Github (devtools::install_github("biodiverse/spOccupancy"), then I think the model should run without an error. If not then let me know! I should hopefully get this updated version of the package up on CRAN within the next few weeks.

Cheers,

Jeff
